task.description: REQ-VALIDATOR gate over REQ-110 (criteria 12-19 and the amendment note only). Apply your role's whole checklist: every criterion checkable by the named test or command and not by a person's taste; no criterion weaker than PLAN's acceptance lines and audit chapter 10 for the same thing (name each one compared); no production check as a criterion; no contradiction with another block, ARCH, a plan amendment or the ORCH answers; the owner's words quoted verbatim where relied on; the goal of decisions/0133 served and nothing outside it added; dependencies and order named; no secret, machine path or reference-product name. Re-derive at least three claims of the analyst's self_check yourself (for example the unchanged rest of the file by hash against HEAD~1 or the commit named in the handoff, a test file that a criterion says exists, a number). Verdict PASS or FAIL with findings by severity (blocking / non-blocking), each with the block, the criterion number, the problem and the exact change you want. WF-03 step 2 gate. Be economical. RULES OF THIS PC (decisions/0110, 0127, 0129): do NOT run npm run check, cd app && npm run ..., node --test, the tools test scripts or the e2e tests; the record of a test run is read from GitHub with gh run view (read-only). Allowed: cd tools && npm run -s traces and handoffs-check; read-only git and gh; your own scripts and fresh clones (git clone -c core.autocrlf=false, npm ci) only in your own folder under <scratch> (the real path is in the message that launched you). Node 22 first on PATH (<node22>). A server you start binds port 0 or a free high port and is stopped by its exact process id; never bind, probe or stop the ports 4780, 4781, 4782 and 4790. One browser at a time on this PC. No git commit, push, pull, checkout, stash, reset or tag. LF line endings. Never write the name of the reference product, nor a path of this computer, into a Sai file or a handoff (write <scratch> or <outside the project>). Fill only the result of your handoff; the top-level status stays PENDING and completed_at null: ORCH closes. English.
